title: Overpass error detection checks the XML '<remark>' marker, but queries pin [out:json] where errors are a "remark" JSON member — error/partial responses are cached and silently baked
evidence:
# Overpass reports errors as 200 JSON with a <remark> element
            text = body.decode("utf-8")
            if "<remark>" in text:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Overpass remark: {text[:500]}")
            with open(path, "w") as f:
                f.write(text)
--- plus tools/osm_extract.py:101 [out:json][timeout:280]; and tools/osm_extract.py:348         elements.extend(r.get("elements", []))
detail: Queries pin [out:json]; Overpass JSON errors return HTTP 200 with a "remark" member, never literal <remark> (XML-only). Timed-out/error responses are cached as valid and silently baked into the committed game asset; determinism verify compares same cache, so passes.
recommended_fix: Parse the fetched body as JSON before caching; reject when data.get("remark") is set or "elements" is missing, and validate expected element counts per query.

title: User-Agent identifies the tool but carries no contact channel, contrary to Overpass mirrors' client-identification policy
detail: Overpass mirrors' usage policy asks clients to identify themselves with contact info; an uncontactable UA risks throttling/blocks of the dev machine's IP on all three mirrors.
recommended_fix: Add a project contact to the User-Agent, e.g. "packet-plumber-dublin-map-spike/1.0 (https://github.com/solarity-services/packet-plumber)".
